image_description: A close-up portrait of a mature male orangutan (Pongo pygmaeus) resting its head and upper torso against a textured, light-grey rock formation. The subject features characteristic long, shaggy reddish-brown fur on the head and shoulders, contrasting with dark, sparse hair on the face. Prominent cheek pads (flanges) frame a broad, flat face. The background consists of out-of-focus green foliage, suggesting an arboreal or zoo enclosure setting.

artifact_observations.location: Fur-rock boundary on the right side
artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight softness and minor blending between the individual hair strands and the rock texture. While likely due to depth-of-field blur, AI generators often struggle with crisp separation of fine hairs against complex backgrounds, resulting in a slight 'halo' or melting effect.

The skin on the face appears slightly overly smooth and uniform compared to the high-frequency detail of the fur. Real orangutan skin often has more pore-level irregularity and wrinkling, though this could also be attributed to lighting/shadow smoothing.
